name: @zantha-ltd/eslint-plugin-fail-fast
description: ESLint rules enforcing fail-fast error handling — nine rules covering silent catch swallows, error-to-null conversions, context-stripping re-throws, generic 5xx API responses (Next.js + Fastify), unguarded response parses, error-surface masking, no-else if-res-ok gates, unchecked body-level failure envelopes (config-driven), and unclassified fail-fast waivers (opt-in).
